# IPluginAction

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · interface

```csharp
public interface IPluginAction
```

An action: changes something when an automation runs or a profile is applied.

## Methods

### ExecuteAsync

```csharp
Task ExecuteAsync(ActionRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
```

Runs the action. Throw [`PluginActionException`](PluginActionException.md) with a message for the user when it fails; other exceptions are reported as unexpected errors.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `request` | The parameters and what started the action. |
| `cancellationToken` | Cancelled when the app stops or the action takes too long. |
